title: In-app purchases, ratings and widgets of iPhone step counters
description:
A hand-made survey of iPhone step counter apps on the US App Store. In-app purchase prices were read off each app's own store page, because Apple's search interface does not report them. Ratings, widget mentions and last-updated months come from the same listings. No app was ranked or scored; this is what the store showed on the date below.

What is inside. 18 apps from the US App Store, measured on 17 August 2026. In-app purchases were checked on 13 of them and 4 sell nothing inside; listed prices run from $0.99 to $49.99. 12 of 18 listings mention a widget and 6 mention a lock screen.

Method. Each app's App Store page was opened and read by hand on 2026-08-17. Purchases come from the 'In-App Purchases' block on that page; 'per its description' means the listing's own text says so, not that we verified the feature exists. The lock-screen column was read on 2026-08-19 from Apple's public listing data, matched to each app by name, rating count and last-updated month; in the same pass the widget and Health columns were re-read that way and agreed with the hand reading in every one of the 18 rows.

What it is not. No app is ranked, scored or recommended here. The facts are Apple's public store listings; what is published under CC BY 4.0 is the compilation, its structure and the description of the method.

Canonical home: https://angelstep.app/data
notes: Cite as: Angel Step (2026). In-app purchases, ratings and widgets of iPhone step counters [Data set]. Measured 17 August 2026. https://angelstep.app/data
